notes.title: SHIATH release date announcement!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 

This is my very first post here on Steam, how exciting! 

And what better way to start the conversation by announcing that SHIATH, the oneiric horror game about the end of the world and self-sabotage, is coming to you on August 29! 

That's right folks, only two weeks from now and you'll be able to step into the shoes of the last human remaining, and witness for yourself what kind of destiny awaits them! 

Stay tuned for more news, and stay safe out there! 

-theJameskrik
